description: Register an MCP server URL as an OAuth resource on an instance so Clerk issues access tokens with that URL as the audience. The first MCP server on an instance also turns on the audience claim and CIMD client registration; later servers leave OAuth settings as they are and report settings that still block MCP clients. Registering a marked URL changes nothing; an eligible legacy Dashboard registration with the same URL is marked as an MCP server. Pass replace_resource_url to replace a registered URL (the URI of a resource cannot be edited). Pass dry_run: true to see what would change without saving. After a save the tool requests a public discovery check when a checker is available.

dry_run.description: Preview the change without saving it.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).

replace_resource_url.description: A registered MCP server URL to replace with resource_url. Omit to add resource_url.

resource_url.description: Public https URL of the MCP server, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp.

workspace.description: The workspace to act in, as its ID or name. A workspace is the Clerk Dashboard organization that owns the applications, not an Organization inside an application (those go in `organization_id` on the tools that have it). Only needed when this connection covers several workspaces; the error for a missing choice lists them.

name: configure_mcp_server
title: Configure an MCP server for Clerk OAuth
